title: T2I-ConBench: Text-to-Image Benchmark for Continual Post-training
reasoning: The paper focuses on creating a technical benchmark (T2I-ConBench) to evaluate the ability of text-to-image diffusion models to learn new tasks sequentially. It assesses dimensions like retention of generality, target performance, and cross-task generalization, but does not benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
